title: SCA Minhag of the Week 194: "The Blessing Recited Before Going to Sleep at Night"

chapters.title: The requirement of Hamapeil and early customs

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the different customs regarding whether or not to include Hashem's name in the blessing of Hamapeil recited before going to sleep at night. He reviews sources and opinions from various authorities including Ha-Ran, Rabbi Chaim Palaji, the Ben Ish Hai, Rabbi Eliyahu Mani, Siddur Beit Obed, Siddur Olat HaShahar, Siddur Tifilat Yeshurun, Rabbi Yitzhak Abadi, and Rabbi Yitzhak Shachabar.
questions: Should the blessing of Hamapeil be recited with Hashem's name?
What did the Ben Ish Hai write about reciting Hamapeil?
What was the custom regarding Hamapeil in Aleppo and Jerusalem?
Why did some rabbis develop a custom to omit Hashem's name from Hamapeil?
